title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Mobile Developer (React Native / Expo)

12 Month +

200-275 USD per day

Remote Euro time zone


Contract | Fully Remote


We’re looking for a Mobile Developer to help build and scale consumer-facing mobile applications. This is a hands-on product role focused on delivering high-quality, performant cross-platform experiences for iOS and Android.

You’ll work closely with backend and product teams to ship features quickly while maintaining clean architecture and a smooth user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and Expo
  • Develop new features with a strong focus on performance, usability, and code quality
  • Collaborate with backend engineers and product to scope, design, and implement functionality
  • Ensure high-quality releases through testing and debugging
  • Own deployments to App Store and Google Play
  • Continuously improve app architecture and user experience


Must Have

  • 3+ years professional experience building mobile applications
  • Strong experience with React Native and Expo
  • Proven experience shipping production apps for both iOS and Android
  • Solid JavaScript / TypeScript skills
  • Focus on performance, clean architecture, and UX
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Fluent spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Experience with React.js
  • Experience working closely with Node.js backend teams
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile apps

title: Analista Funcional SAP - Pleno
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?



Responsabilidades


  • Garantir o suporte e as funcionalidades sistemas BackOffice (SAP, WMS e TMS);
  • Mapeamento de processos, elaboração de requisitos e fluxos;
  • Atuar na análise de melhorias/correções sistêmicas, gerando especificações para o desenvolvimento e implantação de módulos;
  • Mapeamento das integrações, validando os campos existentes e a necessidade de campos novos;
  • Realizar testes funcionais unitários e elaborar scripts com cenários de testes.
  • Analisar funcionalidades e gerar documentação técnica;

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits


  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Endpoint Security Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Endpoint Security Automation Engineer to lead the design, development, and optimization of automated workflows for endpoint security event and issue management. This role will be responsible for integrating and automating processes across platforms such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Power BI, Data Hub, SIEM, and SOAR solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in cybersecurity operations with strong automation, data integration, and process optimization skills. This role plays a critical part in improving detection-to-response time, enhancing operational visibility, and ensuring scalable and resilient endpoint security operations.


Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain automated workflows for endpoint security event and issue management.

Integrate endpoint detection platforms with ServiceNow for automated ticket creation, enrichment, prioritization, and lifecycle management.

Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting using Microsoft Power BI to provide actionable security insights and KPIs.

Orchestrate data pipelines and security telemetry ingestion Data Hub or equivalent data integration technologies.

Design and optimize SIEM use cases and correlation rules to enhance endpoint threat detection.

Develop and maintain SOAR playbooks to automate triage, containment, remediation, and escalation processes.

Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, Endpoint Engineering, and IT Operations teams to continuously improve automation and security processes.

Ensure proper documentation of automation workflows, integrations, and operational procedures.

Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing manual effort and increasing response efficiency.

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members.


Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).

5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, with strong focus on endpoint security.

Proven experience integrating and automating workflows within ServiceNow.

Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.

Experience working with data orchestration platforms such as Data Hub.

Strong experience with SIEM platforms (e.g.,Sentinel).

Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development.

Solid understanding of endpoint security tools (EDR/XDR) or BeyondTrust

Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, REST APIs).

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Analista De Testes (IA) - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista De Testes (IA) - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Responsável por garantir não apenas a funcionalidade, mas também a inteligência, a ética e a confiabilidade dos modelos de IA. Irá desenvolver e executar estratégias de teste específicas para sistemas de IA, validando desde a qualidade dos dados até a precisão e o comportamento dos agentes.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Automação de Testes: Experiência consolidada em automação de testes para aplicações em ambiente Cloud .
  • Testes de IA/ML: Conhecimento em técnicas de teste para sistemas de IA, como avaliação de métricas de modelos (precisão, recall), teste de robustez, detecção de vieses (bias) e validação de pipelines de dados.
  • Ferramentas de QA: Familiaridade com frameworks de automação de testes (ex: Selenium, Cypress, Maestro, Appium), ferramentas de teste de API (ex: Postman) e testes de performance (ex: JMeter, K6).
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimentos básicos em bancos de dados SQL.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de entender a arquitetura de sistemas de IA para planejar testes em todas as camadas (dados, modelo, API, UI).
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Habilidade para pensar criticamente sobre os possíveis pontos de falha em um sistema inteligente e criar cenários de teste que explorem esses limites.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Responsável por garantir não apenas a funcionalidade, mas também a inteligência, a ética e a confiabilidade dos modelos de IA. Irá desenvolver e executar estratégias de teste específicas para sistemas de IA, validando desde a qualidade dos dados até a precisão e o comportamento dos agentes.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Automação de Testes: Experiência consolidada em automação de testes para aplicações em ambiente Cloud .
  • Testes de IA/ML: Conhecimento em técnicas de teste para sistemas de IA, como avaliação de métricas de modelos (precisão, recall), teste de robustez, detecção de vieses (bias) e validação de pipelines de dados.
  • Ferramentas de QA: Familiaridade com frameworks de automação de testes (ex: Selenium, Cypress, Maestro, Appium), ferramentas de teste de API (ex: Postman) e testes de performance (ex: JMeter, K6).
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimentos básicos em bancos de dados SQL.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de entender a arquitetura de sistemas de IA para planejar testes em todas as camadas (dados, modelo, API, UI).
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Habilidade para pensar criticamente sobre os possíveis pontos de falha em um sistema inteligente e criar cenários de teste que explorem esses limites.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: AI Engineer
description:
Must Haves

  • 1+ year of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python or Java development experience, including API development, model training, testing, and general backend engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ingestion workflows, or ETL processes
  • Experience evaluating the quality of Search or Generative AI systems
  • Strong communication skills; able to work independently while providing clear, consistent updates to the team
  • Collaborative team player who is proactive in sharing knowledge and contributing to team best practices

Plusses

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience using LangChain to build LLM workflows with tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other Lucene-based search technologies
  • Experience with Airflow
  • Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures


Day to Day

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (one Mid-Level and one Senior) to join a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and quality engineers. In this role, you will contribute to an enterprise-grade, end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Responsibilities span the full lifecycle, including content ingestion and pipeline development, indexing and retrieval quality improvements, answer generation, and system evaluation. You will work on experimentation, model development, ETL workflows, search relevance, and evaluation frameworks. The role includes deploying code to non-production environments and supporting production releases in collaboration with the DevOps team. This is primarily a hands-on individual contributor role, with an expectation of clear communication, collaboration, and active participation in team discussions and planning.

title: Desenvolvedor Java com AWS
description:
Desenvolvedor Java com AWS


Local: atuação remota

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Nível: Pleno


Sobre a Vaga:

Como Desenvolvedor Java com AWS, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações escaláveis e eficientes na nuvem. Você trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções que atendam às necessidades dos nossos clientes e do negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.

title: Desenvolvedor CERC Backend Sênior
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor CERC Backend Sênior


Sobre a Techsavvy

A Techsavvy é uma software house especializada no desenvolvimento de tecnologia para o ecossistema financeiro e de pagamentos. Desenvolvemos plataformas completas para fintechs, subadquirentes, instituições de pagamento e operações com split financeiro.


Entre nossas soluções está o Mentor, plataforma completa de gestão de subadquirência, responsável por processamento de transações, conciliação financeira, liquidação automatizada e integração com registradoras como a CERC.


Estamos expandindo o time para evoluir a plataforma e construir novos módulos voltados ao ecossistema de pagamentos.


Responsabilidades da vaga

O profissional atuará principalmente no backend da plataforma Mentor, participando da evolução de módulos críticos de processamento financeiro.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de APIs e serviços backend
  • Implementação de regras de negócio financeiras complexas
  • Integração com:
  • Registradoras de recebíveis (CERC)
  • Adquirentes
  • Gateways de pagamento
  • Bancos liquidantes
  • Implementação de rotinas de:
  • Conciliação financeira e conciliação com Registradora
  • Liquidação de pagamentos
  • Gestão de recebíveis (URs)
  • Aplicação de Efeitos de Contrato
  • Otimização de processamento de alto volume transacional
  • Evolução da arquitetura para alta escalabilidade e confiabilidade
  • Participação em discussões de arquitetura e modelagem de dados
  • Apoio técnico ao time e revisão de código


Hard skills

  • Backend: Node.js / Typescript / AdonisJS
  • Filas e processamento assíncrono (BullMQ, Kafka, etc.)
  • Modelagem de dados complexos
  • Otimização de queries


Experiência obrigatória

  • Integração com CERC ou outra registradora de recebíveis (B3, Núclea)
  • Experiência com meios de pagamento / subadquirência
  • Experiência com processamento de transações


Perfil esperado

Buscamos um profissional que seja:

  • Analítico, responsável e criterioso quanto a regras financeiras
  • Capaz de lidar com sistemas críticos
  • Capaz de discutir arquitetura e soluções técnicas


O que você vai encontrar aqui

  • Projetos desafiadores no ecossistema financeiro
  • Desenvolvimento de plataformas reais utilizadas por fintechs
  • Time técnico altamente especializado
  • Espaço para evolução técnica e liderança

title: Outbound Call Center Operator (Customer Care) – HVAC Industry  Remote Position – Based in Brazil | Serving U.S. Customers
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.


The primary goal of this position is to generate service demand and maintain a steady flow of scheduled appointments for field technicians. By contacting existing and past customers, the operator helps prevent equipment breakdowns and ensures customers receive reliable comfort in their homes.


Success in this role means consistently scheduling maintenance visits, delivering a positive customer experience, and maintaining accurate CRM records. This position is an important part of the company's customer care and service operations, directly supporting the productivity of field technicians.


Responsibilities


• Make outbound calls to customers in the company database to schedule HVAC maintenance visits and inspections.


• Contact different customer groups including Comfort Club members, inactive customers, and new prospects.


• Present the company’s preventive maintenance offers and service guarantees clearly and professionally.


• Schedule appointments for HVAC tune-ups and inspections according to technician availability.

Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.

title: [Tech] Cientista de Dados (REMOTO)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
  • Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final.
  • Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados.
  • Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

title: PI Analyst (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Experienced Analyst(s)


a) Responsibilities:

i. Manage PI historians (access, new tags, security, interfaces).

ii. Manage AF SQL servers (access, security, create/edit new databases).

iii. Work with PI analysts to get workflow tags created on in-country PI historians for workflow output.

b) Required Skills:

Soft Skills needed:

Able to work in an Agile environment.

Demonstrate critical thinking, analytical skills, and employ judgment to offer thoughtful, concise input toward resolution of problems.

Able to translate data requirements into business processes and reverse engineer business processes into data requirements.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with strong English proficiency.

Leadership skills needed to successfully promote ideas, coordinate work activities, and plan deliverables within a project team.

This is a hands-on technical role; the analyst should be able to work independently with the business and also in a team environment.

Technical Skills:

2+ years of demonstrated work experience supporting PI and/or PI AF.

Basic understanding of sensor data.

Knowledge and experience of working with the PI AF client.

Adding new databases, elements, creating/editing templates and analyses.

Add additional attributes, calculations, analyses as required from workflow groups and update global templates and existing AF databases (these are requested as the workflow is developed for the site).

SME for AF Builder tool – understand how it works, what is required and be able to teach PI analysts supporting in-country PI historians.

Understanding how PI tags are created and what info is required.

Understanding how PI databases work with each other.

Extensive interface skills especially using OPC UA/OPC DA/PItoPI/PI System Connector.

Properly designing and implementing interfaces that start up quickly and bring in high resolution data (sub-second data).

Interfaces are designed in such a way that troubleshooting can be quick and possibly automated.

Data Archive System skills.

Configuring systems with high tag count and high data resolution.

Expert in data manipulation tools such as: TOAD, Access, Excel.

Applications experience (e.g., VB Programming).

Intermediate to advanced SQL querying (SQL Server/Oracle etc.).

Comprehension of DevOps and Agile development and application to data centric architecture and solutions.

Practical skill sets in Data visualization tools.

Knowledge of other programming languages (as specified in an Order or communicated verbally by Buyer, as needed) and ability to write code.

Profissional focado na experiência do usuário, responsável por integrar novas funcionalidades de forma fluida e intuitiva nos aplicativos de sistemas bancários. Trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as equipes de UI/UX e backend para construir interfaces responsivas e de alta performance.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento para apps, com domínio de React Native e desenvolvimento nativo (Objective C e Kotlin/Swift) .

  • Ecossistema React: Experiência com gerenciamento de estado (ex: Redux) , integração de APIs REST e familiaridade com o ecossistema de bibliotecas do React .

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Clinical Data Analyst
description:
Salary: 15hr - 22hr USD


Job description: We are seeking a detail-oriented Tester/Systems Analyst to join the Global Clinical IT team for one of our medical device clients. This role requires a detail-oriented Tester / Systems Analyst to join the Global Clinical IT team supporting a leading medical device client. This role focuses on mapping clinical trial data from source systems to target platforms, defining transformation rules to align data with the target data model, and validating data accuracy through comprehensive testing. The ideal candidate brings strong experience working with Oracle databases, Tableau reporting, and end-to-end data pipelines (including ingestion, transformation, monitoring, and validation). This position is heavily focused on data mapping and testing, with minimal involvement in requirements gathering.


Must haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 4+ years of experience in a QA/Tester or Data Analyst role with a strong data mapping focus
  • 4+ years of experience with clinical trial databases
  • Hands-on experience validating data mapping and transformation
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and validating data
  • Experience testing Tableau dashboards for data accuracy and visual integrity
  • Understanding of ETL tools and cloud environments (e.g., AWS S3, Athena)
  • Attention to detail, analytical mindset, and ability to work independently
  • Strong communication skills to interface with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Plusses:

  • Experience in medical devices, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas Pleno
description:
Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte a Sistemas Pleno para atuar no atendimento e resolução de incidentes em sistemas internos. Este(a) profissional será responsável por realizar análises técnicas iniciais, identificar causas de problemas e atuar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento para garantir a continuidade e estabilidade das aplicações.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atendimento de incidentes em nível L1/L2
  • Executar análise inicial de problemas e troubleshooting básico
  • Investigar logs e dados para identificação de falhas
  • Abrir e analisar código da aplicação para diagnóstico de issues
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas relacionados a banco de dados
  • Escalar incidentes quando necessário, com diagnóstico detalhado
  • Interagir com times técnicos (desenvolvimento e infraestrutura)
  • Garantir registro e documentação adequada dos atendimentos


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia com suporte a sistemas
  • Capacidade de análise inicial de incidentes e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento intermediário em PostgreSQL (queries, análise de logs e troubleshooting)
  • Conhecimento em SQL
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise de código para identificação de problemas


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em IDE Visual Studio
  • Noções de desenvolvimento em .NET
  • Experiência com sistemas internos corporativos
  • Familiaridade com processos de sustentação (suporte corretivo e evolutivo)

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas Pleno
description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte a Sistemas Pleno para atuar no atendimento e resolução de incidentes em sistemas internos. Este(a) profissional será responsável por realizar análises técnicas iniciais, identificar causas de problemas e atuar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento para garantir a continuidade e estabilidade das aplicações.


Responsabilidades

title: Lead Backend Java Engineer with Devops
description:
Principal Java Engineer - Full Stack Backend Engineer with DevOps experience

Shift Timings: USA, PST (Pacific Standard Time)

Location: Remote (Brazil)


We're seeking a seasoned Java Engineer who can own services end-to-end, from development through production infrastructure management.


What You'll Do:

  • Design and build scalable APIs and backend services using Java
  • Implement security best practices including authentication, authorization, and secure coding
  • Develop event-driven architectures using Kafka
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases
  • Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform
  • Deploy and orchestrate services with Kubernetes


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of Java development experience (Spring Boot preferred)
  • Strong API development and RESTful design skills
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka and PostgreSQL
  • Proven ability with Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Security-minded approach to development
  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Ability to own projects from concept to production


Requirements:

  • Must have overlapping working hours with PST (Pacific Standard Time)
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Self-starter who can work independently

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
A Immunomatics é uma startup sediada em San Diego, Califórnia, com a missão de melhorar os desfechos dos transplantes de órgãos por meio da seleção otimizada de doadores assistida por inteligência artificial (IA).


A empresa busca contratar profissionais brasileiros com conhecimento avançado em arquiteturas de deep learning.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar, testar e validar modelos de IA para estratificação de risco.


O que buscamos

  • Pós-graduação em Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Matemática.
  • Publicação de artigos científicos envolvendo o uso de redes neurais.
  • Experiência em projetar e implementar novas arquiteturas de redes neurais ou em personalizar arquiteturas existentes (CNN, RNN, Autoencoders, Transformers, etc.) para melhorar o desempenho preditivo do modelo.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de métodos e ferramentas computacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Bônus: Experiência em Bioinformática.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
We’re building a talent pool for Data Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong foundation in data modelling (schema design) and SQL experience . You’ll be working across a modern data stack - Airflow, Snowflake, Superset/Looker/HEX, Python, to help power analytics, decision-making, and product insights.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Taking raw production data and transforming it for analytics use.
  • Creating data marts organized by business use vs. data origin.
  • Building AI-ready semantic layer for LLM querying.


You’ll be ideal if you have:

  • Expertise in SQL and data modelling .
  • Proficiency with Airflow, Snowflake, and data visualization tools like Looker, Superset, or HEX.
  • Strong Python skills for data workflows and transformations.
  • Bonus: experience with LLM prompt engineering , RAG, or related AI tools.


Ideal traits:

  • Problem solver with a strong sense of ownership
  • Communicates clearly—both written and verbal
  • Business-minded: focused on outcomes, value, and impact
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments and ambiguity
  • Background in consumer tech or SaaS is a plus


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• 5–6+ years of experience as a Data Scientist • 1–2 years of hands-on experience with Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Large Language Models (LLMs) • Strong Python skills, with the ability to integrate code into existing engineering frameworks and hand off to engineering for production deployment • Proficiency with GitHub and version control workflows • Experience with database structures and cloud computing (any provider is acceptable)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Prior working experience with LangGraph


Job Description


You’ll work closely with two Principal Data Scientists and own a feature within a broader education technology initiative. Your tasks will be assigned via Jira by a project manager, and you’ll collaborate with engineering to push code into production. While you won’t be responsible for defining features, you’ll execute on them independently, relying on the Principal Data Scientist for guidance and feedback. Expect 1–2 scrums per week, formal data process reviews (but no formal code reviews), and a fast-paced environment focused on delivering RAG-based AI solutions that support clients.

description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential KOLs
  • Support KOL and design special campaigns to increase KOL trading volume
  • Build partnerships with KOLs or crypto projects, and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing KOL/clients


Requirements


  • Open to fresh graduates or part-time Business Development
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and passionate about achieving results
  • A good understanding of crypto markets is a plus
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese is essential


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Brand Manager / Brand Development Leader - Casino slots LATAM market
description:
Please note that we are only considering candidates with proven experience in the LATAM market and experience working with Casino Slots products. Please send you CV in English.


Art of Spin is an ambitious iGaming startup within the Altenar ecosystem. We are building the brand from scratch and planning an aggressive international expansion with a portfolio of innovative slot games and unique mechanics.

Our goal is to become a recognized industry player by leveraging creativity and virality — succeeding where competitors rely primarily on massive marketing budgets.


Your Mission

To take the Art of Spin brand from “unknown” to a top-of-mind choice for operators and players, starting with the LATAM market and expanding into Asia and the United States.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Building the brand foundation: Development and implementation of the brand book and corporate website. The website must include a functional Client Hub with technical specifications (RTP, volatility) and marketing assets for partners.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy: Development and execution of launch plans for specific regions (especially Brazil and Mexico), including localization of game content to align with cultural specifics of the markets.
  • B2B promotion and networking: Active LinkedIn development: lead generation, publishing news about signed contracts and game launches. Working with aggregators and direct outreach to operators. Preparation for participation in key exhibitions (ICE, SiGMA).
  • B2C marketing and virality: Identifying and executing bold and unconventional promotional ideas with viral potential. Building and managing a network of streamers (from micro-influencers to major stars) and affiliates. Managing social media campaigns (TikTok, Instagram Reels) to showcase gameplay and big wins.
  • Creative leadership: Providing deep context, strong hooks, and detailed briefs for the design and animation teams.


Candidate Requirements:


  • Deep expertise in iGaming: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in the industry; strong understanding of the entire ecosystem (provider — aggregator — operator — affiliate — player).
  • Knowledge of the LATAM market: Understanding of regional specifics, popular mechanics, traffic costs, and player preferences in Latin America (proven case studies in this region will be considered a strong advantage).
  • Startup mindset: Willingness to work within limited budgets, focusing on efficient organic growth strategies instead of expensive traditional campaigns.
  • Hands-on approach: At the initial stage, readiness to independently lead key processes (strategy, networking, creative briefs), with gradual team building of 3 specialists (SMM, commercial, design).
  • Creative drive: Ability not just to follow a plan, but to actively push the market and the team forward with bold ideas.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to build an international brand from scratch within a dynamic startup environment.
  • Work in a distributed international team (Cyprus, Malta).
  • High flexibility in decision-making.
  • Minimal corporate bureaucracy.
  • Real ownership and impact from day one.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP SR (DBT e ETL)
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.


Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery) , garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders

title: IT PMO
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 7.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.


Sobre a vaga

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração de Empresas, Economia ou áreas relacionadas
  • Boa experiência em PMO, gestão financeira ou funções de controle financeiro de projetos
  • Experiência com gestão de orçamento, previsão financeira e análise de realizado vs. orçado
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos, faturamento, pedidos de compra (PO) e controle de despesas
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos e interação com stakeholders executivos (ex.: CIO, diretores, chefes de departamento)
  • Experiência com governança de projetos ou gestão de portfólio de projetos, preferencialmente em ambientes de TI
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e organizacionais
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com diferentes áreas
  • Inglês fluente ou avançado



O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 52% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .


Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator
description:
Job Title: Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator

Location: Brazil (Remote)


Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Oracle EBS + WebLogic Administrator with 6+ years of experience and strong understanding of EBS R12.2 architecture .


Responsibilities:

  • Oracle WebLogic software installation and maintenance (11.x, 12.x, 14.x)
  • Installing WebLogic patches, service packs, and applying utilities like WebLogic.Admin, WebLogic.Deployer
  • WebLogic application server administration, performance monitoring, and tuning
  • Thread dump and heap dump analysis
  • Configuring LDAP and security realms (basic)
  • Developing automation scripts and integrating with HTTP servers
  • Troubleshooting JAR, EAR, WAR files
  • Understanding of EBS with 2 DB Rack System, EXADATA & ASM
  • EBS patching using ADOP (R12.2), CPU patching on DB/EBS/Tech stack
  • Cloning (Oracle DB 19c and EBS R12.2)
  • Renewing SSL and other trusted certificates on EBS
  • Understanding WebLogic server and applying patches
  • Experience with Oracle Multitenant DB architecture (19c), DR (Data Guard – Physical Standby), RMAN and DB restore
  • Shell scripting and routine Oracle Apps DBA activities


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in middleware administration , WebLogic, and Oracle Apps DBA tasks

title: AI Automations Engineer
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners connects a select group of founders and investors through our private network, Evvolve Circle. With $2B+ in completed transactions and relationships with 305+ family offices globally, we facilitate highly curated introductions in the private markets.


You can learn more about our platform and .


The Role

We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to help build and own the internal automation systems that power our deal flow and investor engagement.


This role sits at the intersection of operations, data, and AI-driven workflows. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining complex automation processes that connect our core systems, structure internal data, and support communication with investors and founders. You will play a key role in building scalable workflows that improve operational efficiency and ensure reliable information flow across our platform.


Responsibilities

  • Design and manage multi-step automation workflows using n8n to support internal operations
  • Build systems that connect and synchronize data across Supabase, Attio, and Airtable
  • Develop structured workflows that process operational data, generate internal reports, and support activity tracking
  • Implement AI-supported workflows that process unstructured inputs into structured outputs
  • Ensure reliability across workflows through testing, monitoring, and error-handling logic
  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate internal processes and improve operational efficiency


Profile

  • 2–4 years experience in automation engineering, workflow architecture, or low-code development
  • Strong experience building workflows in n8n or similar platforms (Make, Zapier, Retool, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with APIs, JSON data structures, and workflow logic
  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL queries (Supabase/PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with integrating AI APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic within automated workflows
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on building reliable, scalable systems
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to take ownership of internal tooling and automation


Why Evvolve?

  • Direct exposure to senior management and the opportunity to contribute to core operational systems
  • A lean, merit-based environment where strong work and initiative are quickly recognized
  • A fast-paced, fully remote team focused on building efficient, high-impact internal tools

title: AI Automations Engineer
description:

Evvolve & Partners connects a select group of founders and investors through our private network, Evvolve Circle. With $2B+ in completed transactions and relationships with 305+ family offices globally, we facilitate highly curated introductions in the private markets.

The Role

We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to help build and own the internal automation systems that power our deal flow and investor engagement.


This role sits at the intersection of operations, data, and AI-driven workflows. Profile

  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL queries (Supabase/PostgreSQL preferred)

title: Cientista de Dados (IA)
description:
Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados com atuação na implementação de soluções com IA , sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Engenharia Cartográfica, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
  • Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
  • Conhecimento em SQL/NoSQL;
  • Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
  • Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
  • Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises e


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;
  • Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em proposição de solução;
  • Utilizar plenamente seus conhecimentos e habilidade para a extração de dados de fontes de diversas origens, ferramentas e formatos, incluindo dados espaço-temporais;
  • Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, modelos de redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML);
  • Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar;
  • Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados;
  • Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Data Science na construção de soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

description:
Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um Auxiliar de Mecânico de Empilhadeiras Elétricas para atuar em nossa unidade em Linhares, ES. As principais atividades incluem auxiliar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de empilhadeiras elétricas, apoiar no diagnóstico de falhas e execução de reparos e realizar inspeções periódicas no equipamento para garantir seu funcionamento pleno. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e exige presença no local.
Qualificações
  • Manutenção e Reparos: Experiência em manutenção de equipamentos, incluindo reparos corretivos e manutenção preventiva para garantir a operacionalidade.
  • Equipamentos Pesados: Conhecimento básico ou experiência no manuseio e manutenção de equipamentos pesados, como empilhadeiras.
  • Identificação de Problemas: Familiaridade com técnicas de identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos em sistemas mecânicos e elétricos.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em funções similares e certificações técnicas relacionadas à área de mecânica ou elétrica são diferenciais.

• Contributes to multidimensional projects that involve multiple teams.

• Responsible for creating, evaluating, and contributing to feature detailed designs.

• Design, develop, and implement software utilizing an agile project cycle.

• Mentor others on the team and raise the bar for technical knowledge across a wide spectrum.

• Demonstrates thorough knowledge of information technology concepts issues, trends and best practices as they relate to Cloud technologies and system integrations.

Familiarity with Kubernetes.

Experience with RESTful architecture and micro-services.

Experience with Kafka

Experience with Terraform

Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery methodologies and tooling.

A deep proficiency of Java (Sprint and Temporal)

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).

title: Analista de Sistemas Mainframe
description:
Atribuições:

  • Levantar requisitos do negócio junto às áreas solicitantes para o entendimento e mapeamento das necessidades;
  • Executar o desenvolvimento do projeto físico, por meio da especificação e codificação de programas, segundo modelo definido em conjunto com a área de arquitetura de sistemas, em projetos ou sustentação dos sistemas;
  • Desenvolver projetos ou atendimentos de alta complexidade, compreendendo a análise da solicitação, definição de requisitos técnicos e prazo e observando os padrões estabelecidos, para aprovação do usuário.
  • Executar testes individuais e integrados de programas e sistemas, incluindo Roteiros de teste e preparação da massa de dados, para verificação de padrões de funcionamento e do atendimento à solicitação do usuário;
  • Homologar processos dos sistemas junto aos usuários, prestando apoio técnico, orientando-os na sua operacionalização e validação;
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, apoiando a equipe de operação, monitorando o resultado produzido, para assegurar o perfeito funcionamento;
  • Identificar possíveis pontos de problemas de infraestrutura, performance ou falhas de sistemas e propor soluções/melhorias, de modo a eliminar problemas no ambiente a curto/médio/longo prazo.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade e desempenho de sistemas, serviços e componentes, objetivando a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos serviços prestados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos de TI;
  • Experiência nas várias fases de um projeto de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Atuação com modelagem de Banco de Dados Relacional;
  • Conhecimento ambiente IBM, desenvolvimento em linguagem Cobol e Banco de Dados DB2;
  • Conhecimentos em processos Devops, qualidade de código, testes unitários;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos.
