title: Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW


Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.


Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear competências técnicas e gaps da equipe, identificando planos de desenvolvimento individuais;
  • Promover e estruturar a fábrica de ABAP, definindo processos, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Definir, implantar e acompanhar o programa de capacitação e certificação das equipes;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de profissionais em início de carreira e de novos consultores, garantindo ramp-up eficiente;
  • Organizar a cobertura de férias, assegurando continuidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o apontamento correto de horas e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e desligamento de consultores, em alinhamento com RH;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico às equipes de sustentação e para demandas de projetos;
  • Colaborar com a gerência e stakeholders para priorização de demandas e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes técnicas SAP ABAP e BW;
  • Habilidade em mapear competências, estruturar equipes e implantar programas de capacitação;
  • Experiência na organização de cobertura de férias, gestão de apontamento de horas e suporte a processos de contratação/desligamento;
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders e capacidade de atuar como ponto focal entre sustentação e projetos;
  • Excelentes conhecimento técnico em SAP ABAP (PI/PO, BTP, Workflow e Integrações);
  • Experiência prática com SAP BW (modelos, extração/transformação, carregamento e performance);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis e governança de fábrica de desenvolvimento;
  • Graduação completa.


Qualificações desejáveis:

  • Familiaridade com BASIS;
  • Experiência anterior em estruturação de programas de treinamento/capacitação/bootcamps;
  • Certificações SAP e/ou experiência em projetos de grande porte;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa);
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).


Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal: .

Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW


Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.


Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear competências técnicas e gaps da equipe, identificando planos de desenvolvimento individuais;
  • Promover e estruturar a fábrica de ABAP, definindo processos, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Definir, implantar e acompanhar o programa de capacitação e certificação das equipes;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de profissionais em início de carreira e de novos consultores, garantindo ramp-up eficiente;
  • Organizar a cobertura de férias, assegurando continuidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o apontamento correto de horas e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e desligamento de consultores, em alinhamento com RH;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico às equipes de sustentação e para demandas de projetos;
  • Colaborar com a gerência e stakeholders para priorização de demandas e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes técnicas SAP ABAP e BW;
  • Habilidade em mapear competências, estruturar equipes e implantar programas de capacitação;
  • Experiência na organização de cobertura de férias, gestão de apontamento de horas e suporte a processos de contratação/desligamento;
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders e capacidade de atuar como ponto focal entre sustentação e projetos;
  • Excelentes conhecimento técnico em SAP ABAP (PI/PO, BTP, Workflow e Integrações);
  • Experiência prática com SAP BW (modelos, extração/transformação, carregamento e performance);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis e governança de fábrica de desenvolvimento;
  • Graduação completa.


Qualificações desejáveis:

  • Familiaridade com BASIS;
  • Experiência anterior em estruturação de programas de treinamento/capacitação/bootcamps;
  • Certificações SAP e/ou experiência em projetos de grande porte;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);

  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :



Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In



You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.



Who are You ?



As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.


Technologies Used:



Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace



The Impact you will have:



  • Software Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, and other stakeholders to design, develop, test, and deploy robust Java applications
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
  • Technical Analysis: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Collaborate with the Team Lead to drive and standarise code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Security: Implement security best practices and contribute to maintaining the security of applications.
  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.




Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Back End Developer
description:
KoreInside is the infrastructure company for private capital markets, delivering clearing, settlement, distribution, and compliance as neutral, non-competitive infrastructure for regulated intermediaries. Architected as the DTCC-equivalent for private markets, KoreInside powers broker-dealers, ATSs, funding portals, transfer agents, banks, credit unions, and RIAs through white-label, API-first platforms. Its core infrastructure includes KoreID, an interoperable investor and issuer identity passport, and KoreChain, the first SEC-qualified blockchain for private securities, enabling scalable, compliant, and auditable private market transactions.


Description

We are looking for a PHP / Laravel/Lumen framework developer with a strong understanding of the PHP programming language. Ability to work on a vibrant and exciting global FinTech company that is building a large-scale enterprise. Working alongside experienced back-end developers as well as our design team.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in developing and maintaining cutting-edge web-based PHP applications in the Laravel framework.
  • Prepare and maintain all applications utilizing standard development tools (Github, Slack, Jira, etc.)
  • Utilize backend data services and contribute to increasing existing data services API using Lumen.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
  • Convey all task progress, evaluations, suggestions, schedules, along with technical and process issues. 


SKILLS:

  • Laravel/Lumen PHP Framework (at least 3+ years)
  • Must have a strong knowledge of Core PHP with OOPS.
  • Experience working with 3rd Party APIs
  • Experience working with MySQL/Maria DB
  • Experience with virtualization technologies like Vagrant/Docker
  • Debug, test, and fix errors
  • Experience with NoSQL  databases such as MongoDB is a plus


Document code development and revisions

  • Using GIT for version control/change management Additional office setting requirements:
  • Work well with a hard-working team
  • Preference for high-quality coffee


REQUIREMENTS:


  • Writing and understanding object-oriented PHP 
  • Experience with Laravel Framework starting from Version 6 onwards
  • Experience with ORM Experience with Cryptographic Library such as OpenSSH
  • Experience with SQL schema design
  • Ability to learn quickly and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Open-minded to new solutions, forward-thinking and strong ability to adapt
  • Git version control workflows
  • Proficiency in design patterns such as facade, repository, observer etc.
  • REST API design
  • Software testing (PHPUnit)
  • MySQL / MariaDB profiling and query optimization


At KoreInside, we offer you

  • Work with a diverse distributed team worldwide
  • Always-on learning and development
  • Collaborative work environment
  • All the tools and supports needed to do an excellent job
  • A dynamic workplace with a great balance of hard work and fun
  • A culture of innovation and a structure in which to innovate
  • A nurturing team-oriented environment with mentorship as a key feature of the dynamic


Privacy Statement

KoreInside is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how KoreInside protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Policy:


Opportunity Statement

KoreInside is an equal-opportunity employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to location, country, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to Staff Accountant


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm EST


Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability


For more information, write to

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Sênior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.



Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer


Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Proficiency in Manufacturing Engineering MES, with a strong background in Syncade MES.
  • Deep understanding of the Life Sciences domain, specifically in regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and validated system environments.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks and sprint-based development processes.
  • Solid knowledge of database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle).
  • Hands-on experience in application architecture, design patterns, and development practices.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering MES, specifically in life sciences or pharmaceutical industries, is required.
  • Candidates must have completed 15 years of full-time education.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform independently and progressively grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for MES applications.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for shop-floor users; diagnose, resolve, and document issues for Syncade.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Quality, and IT to restore service quickly and minimize production impact
  • Propose and deliver practical solutions to business and technical problems.
  • Maintain and improve support knowledge (KB articles, SOPs) and provide targeted user coaching and quick tips to reduce repeat issues.
  • Monitor system health and alerts; identify patterns and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) or continuous improvement suggestions. Conduct and participate in peer code reviews; provide constructive feedback to uphold development standards.
  • Remain current on application development trends, MES technologies, and industry best practices.

title: Junior SMM Manager
description:
We are looking for a Junior SMM Manager to support the growth of the SPLAT brand in Brazil.

This role is designed for someone with basic hands-on experience in social media who is ready to take ownership of content, actively engage with audiences, and grow quickly in a fast-paced international environment.

You will work closely with the team to build brand presence, test content ideas, and improve engagement in the local market.


What You Will Do

Content Creation (core focus):

  • Create and publish content across social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, etc.)
  • Write captions and adapt content for the Brazilian audience
  • Use simple tools (Canva, CapCut, etc.) to produce content

Community Management:

  • Manage comments and direct messages
  • Engage with followers and maintain a consistent brand tone

Influencer Outreach (basic level):

  • Identify and research local micro-influencers
  • Support communication and collaboration processes

Growth & Insights:

  • Monitor trends and competitors
  • Suggest practical ideas to improve reach and engagement


Who We Are Looking For

  • Fluent in English (daily communication with an international team)
  • Native or fluent in Brazilian Portuguese
  • Based in Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
  • Has basic SMM experience (personal projects, freelance, or internships)
  • Understands how modern social media works
  • Can create simple content independently
  • Proactive, reliable, and comfortable with routine execution
  • Motivated to learn and grow in marketing


Application Requirements

  • Please include: links to social media accounts you have managed or examples of content you have created

Applications without examples may not be considered.


What We Offer

  • Hands-on SMM experience from day one
  • Clear tasks and real responsibility (no “theory-only” role)
  • International team and English-speaking environment
  • Fast growth for strong performers

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Key Responsibilities


  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Use AI tools (Nanobanana, Freepik AI, Magic Canva Studio) to generate engaging videos and simple animations for social media.

title: Merchant Onboarding Leader
description:
Job Responsibilities:

Business Process & Strategy Design:

  • Lead the design and optimization of SOPs for the entire merchant lifecycle, from signing to launch (qualification review – store decoration – menu entry – equipment debugging).
  • Establish a scalable and standardized operating system, collaborating deeply with product teams to digitize and streamline complex workflows.
  • Develop differentiated launch strategies and service standards, balancing speed, quality, and strategic platform requirements to support business growth.

Team Management & Delivery Assurance

  • Manage and inspire the Onboarding team (30+), overseeing daily operations (review, decoration, equipment operation, etc.).
  • Build and implement advanced human efficiency evaluation models, maximizing team output through scientific scheduling, task allocation, and targeted skills training.
  • Monitor and improve core efficiency, quality, and quantity indicators; proactively identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.
  • Establish robust internal mechanisms and inspection processes to ensure merchant compliance, accurate information, stable equipment connectivity, and exceptional launch quality.

Cost Control & Resource Integration

  • Analyze and optimize operational cost structures, achieving cost reduction targets through process integration and technology-driven efficiency improvements.
  • Integrate resources to enhance productivity and support sustainable business expansion


Job Requirements:

  • Proven track record and experience in internet operations and B2B delivery, including at least 2 years leading teams of 30+ people.
  • Candidates with experience building process systems from scratch will be prioritized.
  • Deep understanding of merchant operations, menu data structuring, API integration logic, and IT device principles (e.g., printers).
  • Strong data analysis skills, with proven ability to identify inefficiencies and drive impactful solutions.
  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration skills, adept at leading joint initiatives across R&D, sales, and customer service to resolve bottlenecks and enable seamless operations.


Job Highlights:

  • Core Leadership Role: Serve as the key bridge between sales and fulfillment, directly shaping merchants’ online experience and driving business growth.
  • Strategic Career Path: Lead both operational strategy and team management, tackling complex and scalable business challenges with significant impact and visibility.
  • International Exposure: Play a vital role in building diverse markets and business scenarios, growing globally alongside Keeta, and unlocking broad career prospects.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Fullstack Senior


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor com sólida experiência em Next.js e React, além de conhecimentos em WordPress.

É fundamental ter domínio sobre boas práticas de programação, incluindo clean code, revisão de código (code review) e desenvolvimento orientado à qualidade.

Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript é essencial, assim como conhecimento em HTML, CSS e frameworks de estilização como Tailwind CSS ou similares.

Experiência com SSR e SSG, além de otimização de performance web e consumo de APIs REST, é requerida.

A familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código é indispensável.

Valorizamos também boa comunicação, organização e trabalho em equipe.


Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência com outras bibliotecas de JavaScript e frameworks além de React será um diferencial. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis é desejável, assim como familiaridade com ferramentas de deploy automatizado e integração contínua (CI/CD).

Vivência em otimização de SEO e aplicação de boas práticas de segurança web também será considerada um diferencial. Experiência adicional com DevOps ou Docker será um plus.


Resumo dos requisitos:

Next.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, SSR, SSG, APIs REST, Git, WordPress, clean code, code review, boas práticas de programação.

É fundamental ter domínio sobre boas práticas de programação, incluindo clean code, revisão de código (code review) e desenvolvimento orientado à qualidade.

Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript é essencial, assim como conhecimento em HTML, CSS e frameworks de estilização como Tailwind CSS ou similares.

Experiência com SSR e SSG, além de otimização de performance web e consumo de APIs REST, é requerida.

A familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código é indispensável.

Valorizamos também boa comunicação, organização e trabalho em equipe.


Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência com outras bibliotecas de JavaScript e frameworks além de React será um diferencial. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis é desejável, assim como familiaridade com ferramentas de deploy automatizado e integração contínua (CI/CD).

Vivência em otimização de SEO e aplicação de boas práticas de segurança web também será considerada um diferencial. Experiência adicional com DevOps ou Docker será um plus.


Resumo dos requisitos:

Next.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, SSR, SSG, APIs REST, Git, WordPress, clean code, code review, boas práticas de programação.

description:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)


Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers


Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)


Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io


Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua


DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Beyondsoft Consulting, Inc. is a leading technical solutions and consulting partner. We combine emerging technologies and proven methodologies to tailor elegant solutions that solve complex challenges and empower our customers to accelerate their business goals. For the past 25+ years we have been providing a broad range of high-quality IT services, including staff augmentation, business process outsourcing, custom software solutions, test automation, digital enablement, and other software engineering and digital transformation services.


WHAT WE’RE ABOUT:

We believe that collaboration, transparency, and accountability are the values that guide our business, our delivery, and our brand. Everyone has something to bring to the table, and we believe in working together with our peers and clients to leverage the best of one another in everything we do. When we proactively collaborate, business decisions become easier, innovation is greater, and outcomes are better.


Our ability to achieve our mission and live out our values depends upon a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture. So, we strive to foster a workplace where people have the respect, support, and voice they deserve, where innovative ideas flourish, and where people can unleash their brilliance. For more information regarding DEI at Beyondsoft, please go to


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT FOR REMOTE POSITIONS:

For remote positions, all candidates must complete a video screen with our corporate recruiting team.


POSITION SUMMARY:

We are looking for skilled developers and data analysts, has developed numerous tools and systems which assist in data collection, analysis, monitoring, alerting, functionality enhancement, and debugging & verification, ensuring high data quality.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Maintain automated data onboarding and diagnostic tools for AIP partners
  • Monitor ADF pipelines and mitigate pipeline runs as needed
  • Maintain Privacy Dashboard and Bing user interests for Bing Growth team usage
  • Participate and resolve live sites in related areas
  • Data Platform development and maintenance, Notebook based processing pipelines and MT migration
  • Manage the regular data quality Cosmos/MT jobs
  • Online tooling and support such as DADT tools
  • Watch out the abnormal pattern, perform ad-hoc data quality analysis, investigate daily the user ad click broken cases



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Good quality software development and understanding.
  • Ability to quickly communicate across time zones.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Self-motivated
  • Coding Language: C#, Python, Scala, Java,
  • Technologies: Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Hadoop, Cosmos, Scope SQL, MVC
  • Azure resource management: ADF, Azure Key vaults, Managed Identity, Azure Storage, etc.
  • Big data experience is a plus



WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER:

Because we know how important our people are to the success of our clients, it’s a priority to make sure we stay committed to our employees and making Beyondsoft a great place to work. We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits along with a company culture that embodies continuous learning, growth, and training with a dedicated focus on employee satisfaction and work/life balance.


Beyondsoft provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regards to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, and the full employee lifecycle up through and including termination.

description:
WHO WE ARE:

Beyondsoft Consulting, Inc. is a leading technical solutions and consulting partner. We combine emerging technologies and proven methodologies to tailor elegant solutions that solve complex challenges and empower our customers to accelerate their business goals. For the past 25+ years we have been providing a broad range of high-quality IT services, including staff augmentation, business process outsourcing, custom software solutions, test automation, digital enablement, and other software engineering and digital transformation services.


WHAT WE’RE ABOUT:

We believe that collaboration, transparency, and accountability are the values that guide our business, our delivery, and our brand. Everyone has something to bring to the table, and we believe in working together with our peers and clients to leverage the best of one another in everything we do. When we proactively collaborate, business decisions become easier, innovation is greater, and outcomes are better.


Our ability to achieve our mission and live out our values depends upon a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture. So, we strive to foster a workplace where people have the respect, support, and voice they deserve, where innovative ideas flourish, and where people can unleash their brilliance. For more information regarding DEI at Beyondsoft, please go to


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT FOR REMOTE POSITIONS:

For remote positions, all candidates must complete a video screen with our corporate recruiting team.


POSITION SUMMARY:

We are looking for skilled developers and data analysts, has developed numerous tools and systems which assist in data collection, analysis, monitoring, alerting, functionality enhancement, and debugging & verification, ensuring high data quality.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Maintain automated data onboarding and diagnostic tools for AIP partners
  • Monitor ADF pipelines and mitigate pipeline runs as needed
  • Maintain Privacy Dashboard and Bing user interests for Bing Growth team usage
  • Participate and resolve live sites in related areas
  • Data Platform development and maintenance, Notebook based processing pipelines and MT migration
  • Manage the regular data quality Cosmos/MT jobs
  • Online tooling and support such as DADT tools
  • Watch out the abnormal pattern, perform ad-hoc data quality analysis, investigate daily the user ad click broken cases



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Good quality software development and understanding.
  • Ability to quickly communicate across time zones.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Self-motivated
  • Coding Language: C#, Python, Scala, Java,
  • Technologies: Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Hadoop, Cosmos, Scope SQL, MVC
  • Azure resource management: ADF, Azure Key vaults, Managed Identity, Azure Storage, etc.
  • Big data experience is a plus



WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER:

Because we know how important our people are to the success of our clients, it’s a priority to make sure we stay committed to our employees and making Beyondsoft a great place to work. We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits along with a company culture that embodies continuous learning, growth, and training with a dedicated focus on employee satisfaction and work/life balance.


Beyondsoft provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regards to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, and the full employee lifecycle up through and including termination.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.

• Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.


Be fully aligned to our core values:

• Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

• Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

• Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

• Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

• Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.

• Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.

• Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.

• Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.

• Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.

• An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP SD Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ECC environments, business process analysis, and cross‑functional collaboration. The ideal candidate must be bilingual in English, possess hands‑on experience across the full lifecycle of SAP implementations, and be capable of supporting and optimizing Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes in a dynamic, global environment.


Key Responsibilities

SAP Functional Expertise

  • Participate in at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (preferably in a business-facing role).
  • Configure, maintain, and enhance SAP SD and related peer applications.
  • Identify functional gaps and collaborate with technical teams to create and review functional specifications.
  • Support Product Supply requirements ensuring proper SAP configuration, development, and interface alignment (EDI, SAP PO, 3PL, etc.).
  • Work closely with business groups and developers to support, design, and enhance critical applications within SAP ECC 6.0 and integrated systems.

Business Process & System Analysis

  • Conduct business process analysis, documentation, and presentation.
  • Translate end-user requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  • Re-engineer business processes when necessary to drive efficiency.
  • Document process flows, requirements, design specifications, testing plans, and quality assurance outputs.
  • Coordinate and assist with system conversions and data migration activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) with the India SAP support team.
  • Collaborate with local and international teams across Order Management, Physical Distribution, and other functional areas.
  • Assist key users in managing Work Requests (developments, enhancements, production support) including:
  • Initial assessment
  • Determining need for internal/external assistance
  • Following standard procedures for cross-team collaboration

Systems Support & Testing

  • Troubleshoot and resolve transactional issues with internal users, customers, and EDI vendors.
  • Lead and participate in integrated system testing ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Conduct and coordinate user training, documentation, and validation activities.
  • Ensure high-quality procedures, processes, and guidelines across deliverables.

Project & Work Management

  • Manage project-related tasks, work request planning, and scheduling.
  • Assist reporting managers with work prioritization and status updates in the Work Request Database.
  • Support development, enhancement, and production support efforts across business-critical SAP functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bilingual English – mandatory.
  • Proven experience in SAP SD with strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes.
  • Experience with SAP ECC 6.0, EDI integrations, SAP Process Orchestration, and related interfaces.
  • Solid background in system analysis, configuration, and functional specification development.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Experience working in self-directed environments and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system issues and guide users through process and system changes.
  • Strong documentation skills (requirements, specs, testing, QA).

Working Time

  • Must be available to work aligned with Client EST hours , considering the BRT time zone .


What You Can Expect from Us

  • Professional development and continuous growth of your skills.
  • Opportunities to work on international assignments.
  • A collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and innovative environment that values teamwork.

TCS Brazil Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation Voucher
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare Assistance
  • TotalPass
  • TCS Cares – Toll‑free 24/7 hotline offering psychological, legal, social, and financial support
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunities
  • Discounts with universities and language schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – Referral program with hiring bonus
  • TCS Gems – Performance recognition program
  • Xcelerate – Career platform with free mentoring
  • Tata Consultancy Services is an equal opportunity employer, our commitment to diversity & inclusion drives our efforts to provide equal opportunity to all candidates who meet our required knowledge & competency needs, irrespective of any socio-economic background, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity/expression , age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation or any others. We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process.

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects each person. title: Network Associate (Hunter)
description:
Network Associate (Hunter)


A Trust Insight é uma empresa que atua na economia de insights e de conhecimento especializado, com sede em São Paulo, Brasil. Nossa missão é simples: fornecer os melhores especialistas em determinados temas para ajudar nossos clientes a tomar decisões de investimento mais assertivas. Com nossa ampla base de especialistas de classe mundial, nossos clientes recebem respostas valiosas às suas dúvidas sobre indústria e negócios. Nossos clientes são bancos de investimento e consultorias no Brasil e no exterior. Como parte de nossos esforços de crescimento, estamos em busca de um(a) Network Associate excelente para trabalhar de perto com nosso time atual e manter contato diário com nossos valiosos especialistas.


Como Network Associate, você será responsável por fortalecer, ampliar e ativar nossa rede de especialistas. Você terá um papel fundamental na identificação proativa de especialistas relevantes, antecipando as necessidades dos clientes e garantindo que nossa rede permaneça altamente engajada e atualizada.


Essa função exige forte proatividade, conhecimento de mercado e habilidades de relacionamento, além da capacidade de identificar oportunidades e transformá-las em engajamento qualificado de especialistas.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar pesquisas para identificar e recrutar especialistas de diversos setores
  • Apoiar o time antecipando necessidades dos clientes e sugerindo proativamente especialistas e temas relevantes
  • Redigir e validar perfis de especialistas, garantindo a qualidade e relevância
  • Interagir com especialistas para validar sua expertise e alinhar temas relevantes de mercado
  • Negociar com especialistas quanto à remuneração
  • Reativar especialistas inativos na rede e manter relacionamentos contínuos e sólidos
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, notícias de empresas e principais desenvolvimentos da indústria para identificar oportunidades de abordagem proativa
  • Colaborar de perto com o time de Research para melhorar a cobertura e a agilidade da rede de especialistas
  • Auxiliar e acompanhar na preparação e realização de reuniões
  • Melhorar continuamente as estratégias de sourcing e contribuir para a expansão da base de especialistas


Buscamos alguém que

  • Possui forte capacidade de pesquisa e recrutamento (“hunting”)
  • Demonstre alta proatividade e senso de dono
  • Tenha excelentes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação
  • Seja altamente organizado(a), atento(a) aos detalhes e capaz de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades
  • Tenha forte interesse por negócios, mercados e dinâmicas de indústria
  • Se desenvolva bem em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta performance
  • Seja curioso(a), motivado(a) e com vontade de aprender


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês intermediário (espanhol é um diferencial)
  • Forte iniciativa e motivação para expandir a rede
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e facilidade natural para construir conexões
  • Experiência em recrutamento, pesquisa ou funções similares é um diferencial
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação (escrita e verbal) em inglês e português
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, com prazos apertados e altas expectativas


Informações adicionais

  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo (on-target earnings)
  • Contrato em tempo integral

title: .Net Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Desenvolvimento Front-end React
description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento Front-end (React)


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento Front-end com React, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em experiência do usuário, performance e inovação.


Se você busca oportunidades para evoluir sua carreira e trabalhar com tecnologias modernas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações front-end utilizando React;
  • Construir interfaces modernas, responsivas e performáticas;
  • Trabalhar com consumo de APIs e integração com serviços back-end;
  • Garantir boas práticas de usabilidade, acessibilidade e experiência do usuário (UX/UI);
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (design, produto, back-end);
  • Contribuir com padrões de código, componentização e arquitetura front-end;
  • Participar de code reviews e melhoria contínua da qualidade das entregas.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end utilizando React;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 e CSS3;
  • Experiência com bibliotecas e ferramentas do ecossistema React (Redux, Context API, Hooks, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em responsividade e cross-browser;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Noções de testes (unitários e/ou integração) são um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas modernas de build e package (Webpack, Vite, etc.);
  • Interesse por boas práticas de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender continuamente;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho;
  • Interesse por inovação, design e experiência do usuário.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Customer Service Representative (Portuguese)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Handle customer inquiries via live chat, email, and other channels regarding accounts, trading, payments, etc.
  • Assist customers with KYC verification, account security setup, and dispute resolution.
  • Accurately document and escalate customer issues, collaborating with technical teams for complex cases.
  • Stay updated on futures trading rules and promptly communicate platform announcements/risk alerts (training provided).
  • Adapt to shift schedules (if required) to ensure coverage during target market hours.
  • Willing to work weekends and irregular hours which will include night shifts.


Requirements


  • Have an online customer support experience, and proficiency in tools like Zendesk/LiveChat.
  • Fast learner, able to master derivatives trading terminology quickly.
  • Patient, resilient, and skilled in de-escalating high-tension situations.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian/Portuguese user communication styles; finance or customer service experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English is essential.

title: Facebook ads
description:
Company Description

We suggest you enter details here.

Role Description

This is a part-time remote role for a Facebook Ads Specialist. The individual in this role will design, execute, and manage Facebook advertising campaigns to drive engagement, conversions, and growth. Responsibilities include conducting audience research, implementing ad strategies, monitoring campaign performance, and optimizing ads based on analytics. Collaboration with the marketing team to align advertising goals and creating reports on key metrics is also expected.

Qualifications
  • Proficiency in Facebook Ads Manager and knowledge of ad campaign setup, targeting, and execution
  • Strong understanding of audience research, data analysis, and campaign optimization techniques
  • Ability to create compelling ad copy and visuals in collaboration with design teams
  • Experience in digital marketing and strategic ad placements, especially for e-commerce or service-based platforms
  • Strong communication, problem-solving skills, and ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Familiarity with analytics tools like Google Analytics or similar platforms is a plus
  • Prior experience with paid social advertising or related roles is preferred
