title: Consultor de vendas internas
description:
Oportunidade: Consultor(a) de Vendas Internas - Prospecção Ativa

Local: Lavras/MG

Tipo de vaga: CLT | 100% Presencial (Interno na empresa)

Horário: Seg-Qui das 8h-18h e Sex das 8h-17h - (com 1h de almoço) 


Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) de Vendas Internas - Prospecção Ativa, com perfil focado, comunicativo, persistente e com sede por resultados, que queira aprender na prática e crescer junto com uma indústria do setor Alimentício em plena expansão.

Você fará parte de um time que atua com metas, prazos e negociações, participando diretamente do processo de vendas internas (telefone, WhatsApp e CRM), além de atividades operacionais ligadas à área comercial.

Este é o lugar certo para quem deseja se desenvolver comercialmente, com oportunidade real de crescimento, aprendendo a aplicar conceitos de funil de vendas, negociação, relacionamento com cliente e estratégias comerciais.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar vendas ativas e receptivas via telefone/whatsapp. Atuação com Prospecção Ativa de novos clientes.
  • Abertura de novos cadastros e oportunidades comerciais
  • Vendas consultivas focadas em novos clientes.
  • Atualização e gestão constante do funil de vendas no CRM e controle de metas
  • Cumprimento rigoroso das metas de prospecção e faturamento
  • Apoiar no relacionamento com clientes em negociação e no pós-venda
  • Simular pedidos, consultar prazos e negociar condições comerciais
  • Criar e alimentar planilhas de acompanhamento comercial
  • Fazer lançamentos e consultas em sistema ERP
  • Atuação com alto volume de ligações e contatos, com foco em aumento de conversão e geração contínua de oportunidades comerciais.
  • Colaborador(a) estará desenvolvendo papel estratégico de crescimento de mercado para a Pure Seasoning.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Médio Completo (obrigatório). Superior: diferencial
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em horário comercial
  • Pacote Office Básico (Word/Excel)
  • Interesse na área comercial/vendas
  • Somente candidatos que moram em Lavras/MG - *requisito eliminatório


Diferencial Ensino Superior - Cursos Preferenciais (não eliminatórios)

  • Administração
  • Gestão Comercial
  • Marketing
  • Economia
  • Engenharia de Produção
  • Processos Gerenciais
  • Outros cursos com afinidade à área comercial


Competências e Habilidades Desejadas

  • Desenvoltura e boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Perfil comercial agressivo e orientado para metas
  • Persistência, consistência e resiliência diante de desafios
  • Organização, disciplina, proatividade e senso de urgência
  • Capacidade de negociação e argumentação
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em funil de vendas e processos comerciais
  • Raciocínio lógico e atenção a detalhes
  • Espírito de equipe e vontade de aprender rápido

Diferencial: Conhecimento intermediário em Excel (filtros, fórmulas, tabelas)


Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Remuneração fixa
  • Remuneração variável mensal conforme metas atingidas
  • Desconto em produtos da indústria
  • Café da manhã e café da tarde diários
  • Kit de produtos da empresa
  • Cozinha equipada disponível
  • Uniforme


Como Ter Sucesso Neste Cargo

Para se destacar nesta vaga, você precisa abraçar o desafio de vender todos os dias com atitude, foco e consistência.

O sucesso virá para quem tiver fome de resultado, comunicação afiada, disposição para aprender rápido, resiliência para lidar com “nãos” e capacidade de buscar soluções.

Aqui, valorizamos quem assume responsabilidades, corre atrás de suas metas, se envolve com os processos e pensa como dono do negócio.

Se você tem perfil competitivo, comprometido e quer crescer, este é o lugar certo para você!


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Triagem de currículos
  • Teste Comportamental
  • Entrevista presencial
  • Possibilidade de um desafio prático comercial (simulação de venda)


Se você gosta da área comercial, tem energia para vendas e não tem medo de desafios, essa oportunidade é pra você!

title: Node.Js Developer | Senior
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma das arcas da empresa global AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Procurar sempre criar a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas complexos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções inovadoras;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, de fácil manutenção, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código, atuando tanto como revisor quanto como autor, garantindo a qualidade e a funcionalidade das features desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar o comportamento das aplicações em produção usando as principais métricas de saúde e performance disponíveis nas ferramentas de monitoração, buscando insights de melhorias e entendendo anomalias a partir dessas métricas;
  • Atuar no backend que é a interface de consumo dos dados para todos os front-ends, garantindo resiliência e suporte à alta carga de acessos simultâneos;
  • Contribuir com a aplicação responsável pela entrega do site web do produto, utilizando o ambiente como campo de experimentação e aprendizado sobre o comportamento dos usuários.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Node.JS
  • Conhecimentos sólidos do sistema de controle de versão Git;
  • Visão sobre design patterns (Criacionais, Estruturais e Comportamentais);
  • Domínio de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC, SOLID);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos da biblioteca React;
  • Experiência com testes unitários em JavaScript;
  • Domínio de design de APIs REST (preferencialmente com o framework Express);
  • Visão do modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços;
  • Experiência com design responsivo (media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox, CSS grid);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de JavaScript e domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional da linguagem;
  • Conhecimento sobre GraphQL (preferencialmente com o framework Apollo);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoração (métricas de performance e erros);
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de hint/lint (preferencialmente ESLint).

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: ITSM Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.

Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Especialista em Java (Tech Lead)
description:
Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.


Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!


Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar 100% de forma remota, integrando o time de Tecnologia como referência técnica da squad de backend. Será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time, definir padrões de desenvolvimento, promover boas práticas e garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções construídas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Liderar tecnicamente a squad de backend, servindo como referência para o time.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, promovendo evolução técnica contínua.
  • Definir padrões de código e arquitetura, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções.
  • Realizar code reviews estruturados.
  • Definir backlog técnico e quebrar épicos em tarefas técnicas claras.
  • Conduzir refinamentos técnicos e apoiar na priorização de débitos técnicos em conjunto com o PM.
  • Garantir cobertura de testes (unitário e integração) e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento (GitFlow ou trunk-based).
  • Aportar e disseminar conhecimento técnico na squad, evoluindo a maturidade do time.
  • Atuar como elo de contato entre a squad e outras equipes técnicas do Grupo Casas Bahia (Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e SRE).


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Forte capacidade de mentoria e comunicação clara e didática.
  • Capacidade de delegar tarefas conforme a maturidade do time.
  • Liderança pelo exemplo (hands-on) e capacidade de dar feedback construtivo.
  • Organização, disciplina técnica, paciência e facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis: Agile, Scrum e Kanban.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Java 11 ou superior, Spring Boot e APIs RESTful (OpenAPI / Swagger).
  • Experiência com JPA/Hibernate, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA).
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns, Clean Architecture, SOLID e DDD (Domain-Driven Design).
  • Experiência com Kafka (produção, consumo, particionamento, DLQ, retry).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (preferencialmente AKS).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SOLR, MongoDB e Redis.


Informações adicionais:


Local de Trabalho: Brasil | Remoto.


Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:


  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica : Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família.
  • Vale Refeição : Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! ️
  • Seguro de Vida : Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos.

title: Data Analyst (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

title: Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus)
description:
Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus) | Remote


QAT Global, a QAT Global US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Senior Magento Developer in Brazil to join an international project supporting a US client.

This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to performance improvements, technical analysis, and long-term platform stability in a complex Magento environment.


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Hiring Model: CLT only


Main Challenges:


  • Analyze and improve performance across the Magento platform, identifying backend, database, and front-end bottlenecks
  • Review legacy customizations and refactor technical debt impacting platform efficiency
  • Optimize JavaScript execution and storefront rendering performance
  • Evaluate modules, extensions, and integrations according to Magento best practices
  • Support code deployment and version control using GitHub and CI/CD workflows
  • Investigate root causes of production issues and propose scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute with architectural recommendations focused on scalability, maintainability, and security


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience with Magento development (Magento 2 strongly preferred)
  • Strong expertise in Magento architecture, module development, and customizations
  • Proven experience troubleshooting performance issues and legacy code problems
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript performance optimization in Magento storefronts
  • Strong experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, and codebase improvement
  • Experience with repository management and deployment workflows using GitHub
  • Ability to work directly with technical teams and client stakeholders in English


Preferred Background:


  • Magento caching and database optimization
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Code audits and technical health assessments
  • Large-scale e-commerce environments


This role is particularly relevant for professionals who have already worked with complex Magento environments, production troubleshooting, and technical modernization of existing platforms.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer , you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.



Responsibilities

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.

• Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.

• Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review

• Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)

• Support production deployments

• Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.

• Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery

• Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development

• Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.

• Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.

• Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification

• Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks

• Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software

• Effective verbal and written communication

• Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly

• Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed

• Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results

• Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work

• Parse, analyze and understand system log files

• Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels

• Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation

• Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

• Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates

• Migration of platforms and application components.

• Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotation


Qualifications

• Technologist, Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

• At least 7 years of Software Development experience

• Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)

• Java 17+

• Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)

• In memory caching like Hazelcast

• Oracle 12c

• XML, JSON

• Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA

• REST Services

• API Management frameworks

• General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle

• Jenkins, Sonar

• JIRA & Confluence

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues

• Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking friendly and motivated Customer Support Specialists to serve our

customers and restaurant owners by providing assistance regarding account management

or order inquiries. This could include changes to their account, minor updates to their

menu, or inquiries about an order


Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Take inbound calls from either the customer or the restaurant.
  • Make outbound calls to customers or restaurants to follow up on acknowledgement errors.
  • Manage incoming tickets generated from email or text via CRM (customer relationship management portal).
  • Return calls for any voicemails that a ticket is generated for Minor troubleshooting product or service problems reported by the customer or the restaurant.
  • Route calls / tickets to appropriate channels if necessary.
  • Facilitate and document accurate correspondence between the restaurant and customers
  • Miscellaneous clerical duties.


Education:

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)


Experience:

  • 6+ months work experience (Internship acceptable)
  • Fluent in English - Bilingual Spanish/English preferred
  • Must be available for evening and weekend shifts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking / problem solving skills
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Previous call center experience
  • Food Industry experience


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Efficient in operating a computer in a Windows based environment
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) and sales outreach tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deals in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, work autonomously, and drive outcomes.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.



Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
  • Ability to influence the next stages of our growth.
  • Experience working in the ever-changing world of FinTech.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
  • Flexible work environment.

title: Analista de BI
description:
Oportunidade: Analista de BI


Buscamos um(a) Analista de BI para estruturar e evoluir nossa plataforma de dados, atuando de ponta a ponta da ingestão e modelagem à construção de dashboards.


Procuramos um profissional com visão analítica, foco em qualidade de dados e que contribua para um ecossistema confiável e performático.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de ETL com Python;
  • Modelar dados para Data Warehouse (Star Schema e Snowflake);
  • Criar dashboards em ferramentas como Metabase, Grafana ou similares;
  • Evoluir a arquitetura de dados (Medallion: Bronze, Silver e Gold);
  • Automatizar processos e garantir a qualidade dos dados;
  • Traduzir demandas de negócio em KPIs e análises;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle ou MySQL) e domínio de SQL;
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e ETL/ELT;
  • Conhecimento em Python e orquestração de pipelines (ex: Dagster);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de visualização de dados;
  • Experiência com Git, Linux e Docker;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Benefícios:

  • Remuneração compatível com sua experiência;
  • VR no cartão Caju: R$ 750,00/mês + R$ 100,00 de ajuda de custo .
  • Plano de saúde Porto Saúde com coparticipação;
  • Auxílio educação no modelo de reembolso de 50% do valor do curso, com limite de até R$ 500,00 por mês;
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • VR nas férias.


Modelo de trabalho:

  • 100% Presencial (São Paulo)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) + DevOp:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional SRE com habilidades em DevOps para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho das nossas aplicações e infraestrutura. Este profissional atuará em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para promover uma cultura de automação e melhoria contínua.


Responsabilidades:

- Garantir a disponibilidade e a performance das aplicações e serviços, monitorando métricas e implementando soluções proativas.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar e implementar práticas de DevOps, como CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua).

- Automatizar processos de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

- Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.).

- Responder a incidentes e realizar análises de causa raiz para melhorar a confiabilidade do sistema.

- Participar da definição e implementação de políticas de segurança e conformidade.

- Ajudar na gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

- Experiência com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc.).

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Habilidade em solucionar problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações relevantes (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, etc.).

- Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sr (Java | Cloud | Angular)
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent?


Conhecimento técnico:


  • Java (Liberty+JAX-RS ou Spring Boot);
  • Microserviços (REST, SOAP);
  • Design patterns e integração via eventos/filas;
  • Hexagonal;
  • Mensageria;
  • Bancos SQL e NoSQL;
  • Ferramentas DevOps (Git, Maven, ArgoCD);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Angular.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenho de soluções técnicas: Criar soluções eficientes e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio;
  • Arquitetura Hexagonal: Implementar e aplicar para garantir flexibilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Código limpo e manutenível: Seguir princípios de Clean Code;
  • Testes automatizados: Garantir cobertura com JUnit/Mockito;
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs: Criar APIs REST e assíncronas de alta performance;
  • Mensageria: Trabalhar com Service Bus e Kafka;
  • Cloud Azure: Experiência com Azure Functions e Azure Service Bus;
  • Versionamento: Utilizar Git/GitHub com GitFlow;
  • Qualidade e segurança: Usar SonarQube e Fortify;
  • Banco de dados: SQL (DB2/SQLServer) e NoSQL (MongoDB/Atlas).



Formato de Trabalho


Remoto.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com forte atuação técnica em desenvolvimento mobile e integração de sistemas para atuar em um ambiente ágil, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares e apoiando na evolução das soluções tecnológicas da companhia.

O profissional terá papel ativo na definição de soluções técnicas, acompanhamento de fornecedores e garantia da qualidade das entregas de desenvolvimento.


Principais responsabilidades


Responsabilidades

  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis (Planning, Refinamento, Review e Retrospectiva).
  • Contribuir em processos de discovery, apoiando na definição de soluções técnicas.
  • Apoiar a evolução das aplicações mobile e integrações entre sistemas.
  • Acompanhar tecnicamente fornecedores e garantir a qualidade das entregas de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade técnica para novas soluções e sistemas.
  • Apoiar na resolução de incidentes e demandas junto ao time de sustentação.
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa para garantir a integração e eficiência dos processos.
  • Participar de auditorias de TI e apoiar na melhoria contínua dos sistemas.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias tecnológicas.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico com o time.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Android, iOS ou Flutter)
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão com Git
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Squads / Tribos)

  • Experiência em integração de sistemas


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em Flutter
  • Experiência com Firebase
  • Vivência com MuleSoft
  • Conhecimento em Apache Kafka
  • Experiência com Oracle Database / PL-SQL
  • Conhecimento em C#
  • Familiaridade com Figma


Buscamos um profissional que tenha:

  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com diferentes áreas
  • Perfil colaborativo e trabalho em equipe
  • Organização e visão sistêmica
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas
  • Interesse em inovação e melhoria contínua

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Modelo de Contratação:

PJ


Oferecemos :

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina remota de trabalho;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Data Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Maintain and evolve Fraud Deflect’s data stack: reliable pipelines, strong data models, and stable production operations on Linux. Focus is improving what exists, not rewriting everything.


Responsibilities

  • Own data architecture and data modeling for core datasets.
  • Maintain and improve existing pipelines (stability, backfills, performance, data quality).
  • Build/operate Airflow workflows (SLAs, retries, alerting, idempotency).
  • Write and optimize SQL in MySQL (schemas, migrations, indexing, query tuning).
  • Develop pipeline/tooling code in Python.
  • Operate and debug on Linux (services/jobs, logs, incidents, automation).
  • Work within the current stack (Airflow, AWS, MySQL; ClickHouse is a plus).
  • Add basic observability; dashboards/visuals are a plus.
  • Communicate clearly; apply strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL.
  • Airflow in production.
  • AWS experience.
  • Python proficiency.
  • Comfortable maintaining systems on Linux.
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and troubleshooting skills.


Nice to have

  • Observability/visualization (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior Clickhouse experience.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Eexperience in Oracle HCM, preferably Fusion Cloud.
  • At least 1 real Oracle Fusion HCM project/rollout experience (mandatory).
  • Strong functional expertise in Oracle HCM Core HR (workforce structures, person/assignment, approvals, data quality).
  • Proficiency in Reporting (OTBI/BI Publisher) for building and maintaining essential reports and dashboards.
  • Experience with L2/L3 support, including incident management, root cause analysis, and documentation.
  • Familiarity with Release management, quarterly updates assessment, UAT coordination, and regression testing.
  • Comfortable with data loads (HDL/Spreadsheet Loader) and integration analysis (HCM Extracts/REST).
  • Professional working proficiency in English (mandatory).
  • Oracle certification in HCM (Core HR/Journeys/Reporting) is a plus.
  • Experience in the banking/financial services sector is valued.
  • Available to work hybrid in Lisbon- Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior, você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas, APIs e serviços que compõem ao ecossistema de produtos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais:


  • Criar e manter APIs/Serviços, garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar sistemas para melhorar a performance.
  • Trabalhar na integração de sistemas internos e de terceiros.
  • Participar de reuniões para entendimento de requisitos, refinamento de demandas e planejamento de sprints.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) para garantir a estabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar sistemas/serviços em produção, analisando logs e métricas para garantir a estabilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento, proteção de dados e autenticação de sistemas.
  • Em conjunto com a liderança técnica e arquitetura, avaliar e propor novas ferramentas, tecnologias e práticas para melhorar o ecossistema da empresa
  • Documentar processos e melhorias implementadas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência em Java e outras linguagens de programação. (experiência mínima de 4 anos )
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Habilidade para identificar e solucionar desafios técnicos de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código com Git;
  • Noções de banco de dados PostgreSQL e Mongo;
  • Experiência com Quarkus ou Spring Boot ;
  • Busca constante por melhorias nos sistemas e processos existentes.
  • Capacidade de documentar código e comunicar ideias técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas: Busca contínua por aprendizado e soluções eficazes. Capacidade de colaborar em equipe, receber feedback construtivo e contribuir para o sucesso do projeto


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com sistemas legados desenvolvidos a partir do Java 8;
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação Node, Typescript, React e Angular;
  • Familiaridade e experiência com o uso de Docker para implantação e gestão de contêineres;
  • Experiência prévia com aplicativos de gerenciamento de caches e/ou sistemas de filas de eventos.



Por que #VemParaSyonet ? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente

title: Analista de QA Pleno
description:
Analista de QA Pleno


Modelo de Contratação: PJ

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) profissional de QA para atuar na validação da qualidade de aplicações web e APIs, garantindo que as entregas atendam aos requisitos funcionais e técnicos definidos.

A pessoa terá papel importante na definição de estratégias de teste, desenvolvimento de automações e colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para prevenir falhas e elevar o padrão das entregas.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, criar e executar casos de teste funcionais, regressivos, exploratórios e de integração;
  • Garantir a qualidade das aplicações web e APIs, atuando de forma preventiva desde o início do desenvolvimento;
  • Validar regras de negócio, fluxos críticos e cenários de borda com alto nível de critério e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Reproduzir bugs reportados, documentando cenários, evidências e passos para reprodução de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web e APIs;
  • Apoiar na definição da estratégia de automação, priorizando testes que gerem maior valor;
  • Integrar automações aos pipelines de CI/CD, contribuindo para entregas mais seguras e confiáveis;
  • Participar ativamente de refinamentos, reviews e discussões técnicas, contribuindo com o olhar de qualidade;
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na prevenção de falhas e melhoria contínua dos processos.
  • Documentar planos de teste, cenários automatizados, padrões e boas práticas de QA;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos de testes, qualidade e desenvolvimento;
  • Atuar como guardião(a) da qualidade, questionando, validando e elevando o padrão das entregas.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimentos de técnicas de teste de software (funcional, regressão, etc.).
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de automação de testes.
  • Conhecimentos de metodologias ágeis e de desenvolvimento de software.


Perfil Desejado

  • Perfil analítico e organizado
  • Proatividade para aprender
  • Boa comunicação para interação com diferentes áreas

title: Gerente de Operações Financeiras (Financial Operations Manager)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards.
  • Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil.
  • Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.g., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
  • Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly.
  • Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning.
  • Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation.
  • Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

title: Partner Technical Advisor
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are seeking a highly skilled for a Partner Technical Advisor who wants to learn and transform his career.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, architect, build PoCs (Proof of concept) and support customer and partner requirements · Drive technical sales support to customers
  • Present innovation, features and standard architectures, Demos and POCs
  • Build customer and partner ready presentations, materials
  • Provide training to customers and partners
  • Conduct workshops for customers and partners via web or on-site (availability to travel across the country).
  • Maintain updated info on all activities within one´s work sphere Continuously scan the environment for new business/technology.
  • Participate in the development of strategic plans to support commercial and pre-sales activities. · Manage the flow of information in a timely and correct manner.
  • Manage calendars and schedule meetings.
  • Perform a variety of administrative tasks and support management
  • Create and present performance reports to C-levels
  • Cross Group Collaboration
  • Work in partnership across multiple v-teams
  • Create Team training plan to be up to date with new Microsoft Technologies or features
  • Planning and organization capacity


Must have:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related
  • Experience in pre-sales of Microsoft Technologies
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Discretion and confidentiality
  • Assertive communication
  • Self-management
  • Self-motivated
  • Problem management
  • Resilience
  • Proactive
  • Excellent time management skills
  • At least one certification in Microsoft Technologies (Fundamentals) o MS-900, AZ-900, DP-900, AI-900, SC-900, MB-910, MB-920


Good to have:

  • Speaker (Training) at events, workshops or/and training sessions
  • Knowledge in Agile methodologies


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform



At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience


5+ years of experience in delivery lead role

Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment

Working knowledge of:

• ETL processes and data pipelines

• BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectively


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts

Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environments


Job Description


Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvimento e Programação Especialista (DEVES) para se juntar ao nosso time. Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar integrações em IBM ACE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance. Além disso, irá projetar e implementar APIs e serviços SOA, seguindo padrões corporativos de arquitetura e conduzir iniciativas de modernização de integrações, reduzindo acoplamento e aumentando escalabilidade. O(a) DEVES também apoiará a evolução para arquiteturas cloud-native, integrando soluções on-premise e cloud, garantindo padrões de segurança, governança e qualidade de código.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida com IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM Integration Bus (IIB) em ambientes produtivos.

- Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de integração, APIs REST/SOAP, mensageria e padrões SOA.

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs corporativas, incluindo versionamento, segurança e governança.

- Vivência em modernização de integrações legadas, migrando soluções monolíticas ou ESB tradicionais para arquiteturas mais modernas.

- Experiência prática com Java e/ou Go aplicados a integrações e serviços.

- Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e conceitos de containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Domínio de boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, mTLS).

- Experiência com pipelines CI/CD e automação de deploy.

title: Proofreader (TEMP CONTRACT)
description:
Proofreader


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


As a Proofreader, you will work on a diverse range of immigration-related template, forms, and letters, applying a range of writing and editing skills to understand our clients' needs and ensuring our letters meet the highest quality standards. A Junior Proofreader must be proficient in basic and advanced grammar rules and understand how they are used within our style guides. Our ideal candidate is meticulous in reviewing copy, noting errors such as punctuation, spelling, and word usage, and knows how to check statements for accuracy.


This is a temporary contract role. The duration of the contract will be mid/end April 206 to end of June 2026. Working hours during this period will be Monday – Friday 9:00AM – 5:00PM Eastern Standard Time.


Main Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review documents for grammar, spelling, and style
  • Fact-check dates and other statements for accuracy
  • Make corrections and suggest edits
  • Manage multiple proofreading projects and meet proofreading deadlines
  • Communicate effectively with the writers and other staff to ensure documents meet all company guidelines


Requirements:

  • A strong education background
  • English proficiency (speaking and writing)
  • Expert command of English grammar and punctuation
  • Exceptional fluency with Microsoft Word, including relevant shortcuts and advanced features like Paragraphs, Styles, Templates, and Mail Merge fields
  • Highly-focused and detail-oriented
  • Proven ability to multitask, exhibit flexibility, and remain responsive as demands change
  • Ability to work well in both independent and highly collaborative settings
  • Ability to excel in fast-paced work environment
